## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Pending Booking
where: BookingRepository (uses), src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts, component persistence
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
return [...this.bookings.values()].filter((b) => b.status === "pending");

response.rationale: A is a subset of B, not another name for it. In src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts (BookingRepository, node 2e3c5728fffb0180), "Pending Booking" comes from filtering bookings by status: `[...this.bookings.values()].filter((b) => b.status === "pending")`. In src/business/sessionService.ts (SessionService, node 42a26b41b626f9ec), "Booking" is the booking entity in general; that code adds up `b.tickets` over the active bookings. Both rest on the same Booking record, but "pending" picks out one stage in a booking's life. Since A is a narrower case of B and not a second name for the same concept, they don't count as the same. Confidence is moderate because both point to the same underlying entity.
